title: Best app
body: It’s my first day and I’m so creative I really want to thank this app it’s so amazing
author: Nnnodnsjjsn

title: Practical and simple to use
body: Very nice app, very simple to use: looks very nice so is a pleasure to look at, which helps me a lot to use it. It is well attuned to what ADHDers need in a planning tool
author: Carien1985

title: Schittert dankzij eenvoud
body: Ik doe met deze app wat ik eerst deed in to do apps. Met als verschil: ik probeer normale to do apps altijd naar mijn hand te zetten. Dit kost tijd en leidt af van waar het om gaat: taken toevoegen, uitvoeren en afvinken. Ook voegt de community echt wat toe. Deze app kan wel eens een blijvertje zijn!  Hopelijk blijft deze vrolijke ADHD to do app zo eenvoudig en blijft het mij helpen!
author: RSRS51

title: Watch out though Adhd trap
body:
Started the free trial. And basically got overwhelmed by it in the first 48hrs. So found the unsubscribe part after finding the settings part which is allready quite a hassle on it’s own. 
Smashed that unsubscribe immediately, even smashed it twice just to be sure. 
But basically it gives you instructions how to do it on your phones setting instead of in the app it self. 
But yup….. 
guess what? 
Totally adhdidn’t saw that one. 
So paid about let’s say to round up. 70€,- for an app that i adhdon’t gonna use. 
🤦‍♀️

But one star is to qruell for the initiative though
author: dundundons

title: I’m not alone
body: I’ve learned that my weird habits were not that weird.
author: Lenssaa

title: Like
body: I like the app, it is sad it cost money and I would like more attention to more stories and tips, like audhd! Thankyou!
author: anne.hallo

title: First hour
body: App is really engaging. Am considering buying it if it keeps this je no se qua.
author: Bisslik

title: There’s a bug
body:
Have you guys not tested this app?
The person telling the lessons gets cut off and it advances to the next slide.
That so frustrating especially for someone having ADHD.
Will not continue my subscription.
author: Cyberman78

title: Bug
body: Its bad, the auto scroll is faster than the spoken explanation, very annoying bug. I have to cancel my subscription
author: Sam1050

title: Absolutely love the idea
body: I absolutely love the idea of this app and huge respect and admiration for the developers!!! I’m sure there are good reasons to justify the price, but for me it’s kind of much.. I’m a university dropout with low income and ADD. I feel I can’t miss 216 on a yearly base.
author: Gigi91v

title: Looks amazing, but on the pricey side!
body:
It looks like everything I could ever wish for, if only it would be around $10 to make it more available! Now I’m too afraid to start the free trial because I just know I’ll forget to terminate the membership if I don’t like it or use it as much.

Ironic greetings,

Someone with adhd
